name: content-api-mcp
description: Ask questions about Binogi's lesson content: lessons, videos, subtitles, quizzes, concepts, learning outcomes and the catalog. Read-only.
long_description: Gives Claude read-only access to Binogi's content-api. Ask things like "How many lessons have videos with German subtitles?" or "Which published lessons are missing a Swedish title?". The extension can't create, change or delete content. Each question that triggers a tool call is logged locally to ~/.content-api-mcp/searchlog.jsonl on your computer.

content_api_key.title: Content API key
content_api_key.description: The api-key for the content-api environment below. Ask the content team for it; keep it private.
